gallery-grid.looks: A grid of 2 to 4 equal columns of tiles: photos filling their slot, plain text tiles, or Statistics and card blocks placed directly in it.
gallery-grid.use: A mosaic mixing photos and big figures, e.g. in an impact report.

fields.image: A photo that fills this tile.
fields.text: Text for a plain text tile instead of a photo; ignored when there is an image.
